value: Residential / Multifamily — Favored
• A widening own-versus-rent affordability gap supports durable rental demand (exhibit).
• Record new deliveries are peaking and set to taper, easing rent pressure.
• A key area of interest for new capital deployment.
Key Themes
• Core real-estate values are stabilizing after the 2023–2024 repricing; U.S. private funds have turned positive over the past year (see exhibits).
• We favor industrial / logistics and multifamily, remain underweight office, and are selective in retail.
• Leverage discipline and patient deployment into the recovery.

value: Macro & Capital Markets
• Global macro is stabilizing; core values are recovering following the significant 2023–2024 repricing.
• U.S. private real estate fund returns have moved back into positive territory over the trailing year (exhibit).
• Cap rates have largely stabilized while the spread over Treasuries has widened, restoring the real-estate risk premium (exhibit).
• Transaction activity is rebounding from cyclical lows as rate volatility eases and bid-ask spreads narrow.
• We maintain leverage discipline and prefer moderate loan-to-value as financing normalizes.
